title: Completed finite quotient projection is invertible and natural
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $R_T$ for the completed coefficient sheaf and $R_{T,n}$ for its positive finite quotient sheaf, indexed by $n+1$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Let $F=Rf_{*,d}$ and $G_n=Rf_{*,R_n}$ be the direct images using the canonical completed and finite coefficient maps [def-sf-completed-module-direct-image]. Write $E_{T,n}\dashv U_{T,n}$ for extension and restriction along the limit projection $R_T\to R_{T,n}$ and $e_n:U_{X,n}F\cong G_nU_{Y,n}$ for the derived comparison whose ordinary comparison is identity on sections and whose derived units are the universal right-derived units. Define $\pi_n(K):E_{Y,n}F(K)\to G_nE_{X,n}(K)$ as the scalar-adjunction transpose of $F(\eta_{X,n}(K));(e_n)_{E_{X,n}K}$. Then $\pi_n(K)$ is invertible for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every unbounded $K\in D(R_X)$. Moreover, for every $h:K\to L$, one has $E_{Y,n}(F(h));\pi_n(L)=\pi_n(K);G_n(E_{X,n}(h))$.

proof.text: Construct the finite quotient unit-module identification by the canonical finite-ring comparison and its limit-projection equation. Normalize the completed and finite complex units with the generic identity-factor theorem. Retain the ordinary functor presentations, and supply their defining equalities, the section-normalized ordinary comparison and its universal-derived-unit-normalized derived comparison.

Apply the proved scalar-projection perfectness theorem to these finite coefficient sheaves, the nth quotient identification and the input K. That theorem combines tensor projection perfectness with cancellation and conservative restriction.

For naturality apply the Hom adjunction bijection to both sides. Naturality of that bijection reduces the assertion to naturality of the scalar unit and e. Functoriality and associativity give the equality, independently of perfectness.

theorem completedDirectImageProjectionFormula_properties (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d))),
      IsIso (completedDirectImageProjectionFormula f d n K)) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K L : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)))
      (h : K ⟶ L),
      (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicProjection Y d n)).map
          ((completedDerivedDirectImage f d).map h) ≫
        completedDirectImageProjectionFormula f d n L =
      completedDirectImageProjectionFormula f d n K ≫
        (completedFiniteDerivedDirectImage f d n).map
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicProjection X d n)).map h)
